# Amazon.sa

> Amazon.sa is Amazon’s Saudi Arabia marketplace for online shopping, digital services, customer support, and seller programs.

Amazon.sa serves customers in Saudi Arabia with localized shopping, delivery, payments, Prime membership, device and digital content support, and marketplace tools for sellers and brands. The site includes retail browsing, account self-service, help content, and business programs.

## Shopping & Discovery
- [Amazon.sa Home](https://www.amazon.sa/): Main Saudi marketplace homepage for browsing products, offers, and personalized recommendations.
- [Today's Deals](https://www.amazon.sa/deals): Central deals hub featuring limited-time discounts across major shopping categories.
- [Best Sellers](https://www.amazon.sa/gp/bestsellers): Popular products ranked by sales across departments and subcategories.
- [New Releases](https://www.amazon.sa/gp/new-releases): Recently launched products gaining traction across the Amazon.sa catalog.
- [Movers and Shakers](https://www.amazon.sa/gp/movers-and-shakers): Products with the biggest recent sales-rank gains across categories.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.amazon.sa/gift-cards): Purchase, send, and manage Amazon.sa gift card options.
- [Amazon Bazaar](https://www.amazon.sa/haul/store): Low-cost shopping area focused on budget-friendly products and value finds.

## Customer Service & Help
- [Customer Service](https://www.amazon.sa/gp/help/customer/display.html): Main help center for orders, payments, returns, and account issues.
- [Your Orders](https://www.amazon.sa/gp/css/order-history): Order history page for tracking, returns, invoices, and purchase details.
- [Returns Center](https://www.amazon.sa/returns): Start and manage eligible returns, replacements, and refund requests.
- [Contact Us](https://www.amazon.sa/hz/contact-us): Support contact entry point for account, delivery, and order problems.
- [Shipping Rates and Policies](https://www.amazon.sa/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GKM69DUUYKQWKWX7): Help page covering shipping options, fees, and delivery expectations.
- [About Our Returns Policies](https://www.amazon.sa/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GKM69DUUYKQWKWX7): Policy information for return eligibility, timelines, and refund handling.

## Account & Preferences
- [Your Account](https://www.amazon.sa/gp/css/homepage.html): Account dashboard for orders, addresses, payments, and preferences.
- [Sign In](https://www.amazon.sa/ap/signin): Authentication page for customer account access and session management.
- [Manage Your Content and Devices](https://www.amazon.sa/hz/mycd/myx): Manage Kindle content, apps, devices, and digital settings.
- [Customer Preferences](https://www.amazon.sa/customer-preferences/edit): Update language, region, and shopping experience preferences.
- [Your Addresses](https://www.amazon.sa/a/addresses): Manage shipping addresses and delivery destinations for orders.
- [Your Payments](https://www.amazon.sa/cpe/yourpayments/wallet): View and manage cards, payment methods, and wallet settings.

## Prime & Membership
- [Amazon Prime](https://www.amazon.sa/prime): Prime membership overview with shopping, delivery, and entertainment benefits.
- [Prime Video](https://www.amazon.sa/gp/video/storefront): Streaming video destination for included and rentable entertainment content.
- [Prime Gaming](https://gaming.amazon.com/): Gaming benefits site for in-game content, offers, and monthly rewards.
- [Prime Help](https://www.amazon.sa/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=G6LDPN7YJHYKH2J6): Help content explaining Prime membership features, billing, and support topics.

## Devices & Digital Services
- [Kindle Store](https://www.amazon.sa/kindle-dbs/storefront): Browse ebooks and Kindle reading content available through Amazon.
- [Appstore for Android](https://www.amazon.sa/mobile-apps/b?node=21870329031): Amazon Appstore landing page for Android apps and related content.
- [Amazon Photos](https://www.amazon.sa/b?node=21870330031): Information and access point for Amazon Photos services and benefits.
- [Amazon Music](https://music.amazon.com/): Music streaming service for listening, playlists, and subscriptions.
- [Alexa & Echo Devices](https://www.amazon.sa/b?node=21870328031): Browse Alexa-enabled devices and smart home voice assistant products.

## Selling on Amazon
- [Sell on Amazon](https://sell.amazon.sa/): Seller program overview for listing products and growing a business on Amazon.sa.
- [Seller Central](https://sellercentral.amazon.sa/): Seller portal for inventory, orders, advertising, and account management.
- [Fulfillment by Amazon](https://sell.amazon.sa/fulfillment-by-amazon): FBA program information for storage, packing, and delivery services.
- [Amazon Ads for Sellers](https://advertising.amazon.com/solutions/products/sponsored-products): Advertising tools for promoting listings through sponsored placements.
- [Seller University](https://sell.amazon.sa/learn): Educational resources and onboarding materials for marketplace sellers.

## Business, Brand & Corporate
- [About Amazon Saudi Arabia](https://www.amazon.sa/b?node=21512463031): Corporate information and local Amazon.sa background for Saudi customers.
- [Amazon Jobs](https://www.amazon.jobs/): Global careers portal for roles across Amazon business units and regions.
- [Amazon Science](https://www.amazon.science/): Research site covering scientific work behind Amazon technologies and systems.
- [Amazon Sustainability](https://www.aboutamazon.com/planet): Corporate sustainability initiatives, goals, and environmental reporting.
- [Amazon Press Center](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news): Newsroom for announcements, launches, and company updates.

## Policies & Legal
- [Conditions of Use](https://www.amazon.sa/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201909000): Terms governing use of Amazon.sa services and site features.
- [Privacy Notice](https://www.amazon.sa/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201909010): Privacy policy describing data collection, use, and customer choices.
- [Interest-Based Ads](https://www.amazon.sa/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201909150): Information about advertising preferences and personalized ads controls.
- [Cookies Notice](https://www.amazon.sa/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201909250): Details on cookie usage, categories, and browser-related choices.
- [Help & Customer Service](https://www.amazon.sa/gp/help/customer/display.html): Central support and policy navigation for customer-facing topics.

## Programs & Specialized Shopping
- [Amazon Fresh](https://www.amazon.sa/fresh): Grocery shopping experience for fresh food and household essentials.
- [Pharmacy](https://www.amazon.sa/pharmacy): Health and pharmacy shopping area for eligible products and services.
- [Subscribe & Save](https://www.amazon.sa/subscribe-and-save): Recurring delivery program for everyday essentials with savings.
- [Registry & Gifting](https://www.amazon.sa/b?node=21870331031): Gift planning and registry-related shopping tools and features.
